title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: After Sally takes \(20\) shots, she has made \(55\%\) of her shots. After she takes \(5\) more shots, she raises her percentage to \(56\%.\) How many of the last \(5\) shots did she make?

solutions.text:
Sally made \(20 \times 0.55 = 11\) of her first \(20\) shots. Then we get that \[ \dfrac{11 + x}{25} = 0.56, \] which tells us that \[ 11 + x = 14 \] and \(x = 3.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Find how many shots Sally had made after \(20\) shots.
Find how many total made shots she had after \(25\) shots.
